Retoob TV 0.7.0 preview 1

The Bauhaus redesign brings a geometric yellow e, orange RSS arc and blue dot to the Retoob wordmark, launcher and TV banner. TV screens use cream text on charcoal with clear yellow focus.

Home shelves, See all cards, the feed selector, Settings, source notes, Family pairing and update screens share the refreshed presentation. Feed subscriptions, hidden choices, saved positions and playback behavior are preserved.

Install over the existing signed preview. This update includes the all-feed Profile B reader from 0.6.1.
